description: MyGeoportal (Malaysia Geospatial Data Infrastructure) is a data portal run by Malaysian Centre for Geospatial Data Infrastructure (MaCGDI). MyGeoportal is the national geospatial data infrastructure portal: a metadata catalogue and map viewer for layers from Malaysian agencies on transport, utilities, boundaries, hydrology and hazards. Coverage: Malaysia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as wms, wfs; access is free to search; some layers need agency approval. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Utama | MyGeoportal") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support infrastructure and flood exposure studies of Malaysia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
